name: Annual Heating Energy Demand Structural Composition
description: Annual heating energy demand is structurally composed from three seasonal contributions: winter (Oct–Mar), shoulder (Apr, Sep), and summer (May–Aug). Structural UPR: annual CZ is Minkowski sum of seasonal CZs.
